question: In November 2021, Pratap Singh Khachariyawas was allocated food and civil supplies in the Cabinet expansion of the state of ______.
solution: The correct answer is__** Rajasthan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Pratap Singh Khachariyawas** is an Indian National Congress politician. • He is presently the Cabinet Minister** (Transport and Soldiers Welfare Dept.) in the Government of Rajasthan.** • He is also one of the Cabinet Ministers in the government, which is headed **by Ashok Gehlot, the CM of the state.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97047f9c637af8fb772f7f4345ad2a6912f7000b6d565bf19536feba5b8afe02.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • Portfolio • Minister • Party • Minister of Finance Minister of Corporate Affairs • Nirmala Sitharaman • BJP • Minister of Road Transport and Highways • Nitin Gadkari • BJP • Minister of External Affairs • Subrahmanyam Jaishankar • BJP • Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare • Narendra Singh Tomar • BJP 6f:T12a0, सही उत्तर **राजस्थान**__ है।
